verdict.rationale: Render's own marketing explicitly claims free TLS certificates for every domain, including wildcards, and lists custom domains as a documented feature. The automatic-renewal part of the story is never stated, and the claim is a single marketing line without detailed docs. missing for 10: documented automatic certificate renewal, in-depth first-party docs on wildcard certificate provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Free TLS certificates for every domain, including wildcards.
